changelog:
**Big Change: Adds full auto-detection and repair workflow for Microsoft Teams China integration in OpenClaw.**

- Introduced 18 new files including reference documentation, troubleshooting guides, and script utilities for diagnosis and auto-repair.
- Added automatic version detection and one-click patch workflow to handle OpenClaw and plugin upgrades.
- Implemented comprehensive diagnosis, patching, and verification phases (6 stages), including SDK and environment variable configuration for China endpoints.
- Automated Gateway restarts post-patch, preserving active sessions.
- Outputs standardized repair reports; supports both manual trigger and auto-run via heartbeat or cron.
- Enhanced documentation and error scenario mapping for easier troubleshooting and user self-service.
